BEGIN_PGML The expression [`17.5-h`] gives the run of a stairstep when the rise is [`h`] inches. Determine the run for each step of a staircase where the rise is 7.75 in.
[_]{$run}{10}
END_PGML
########## # Solution ##########

[``` \begin{aligned} 17.5-\substitute{7.75}\amp=9.75\text{.} \end{aligned} ```]
So the run is 9.75 in.
